index CREATE INDEX idx_checkpoints_history_listener_id ON core.observer_checkpoints_history USING btree (listener_id)
index CREATE INDEX idx_checkpoints_history_updated_at ON core.observer_checkpoints_history USING btree (updated_at DESC)
index CREATE INDEX idx_observer_checkpoints_updated_at ON core.observer_checkpoints USING btree (updated_at DESC)
index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX observer_checkpoints_history_pkey ON core.observer_checkpoints_history USING btree (id)
index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX observer_checkpoints_pkey ON core.observer_checkpoints USING btree (listener_id)
